WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT timespan,
         risk_margin_record_count,
         risk_margin_record_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       risk_margin_record_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY timespan;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean across time-in-force values present among matched records; NULL timespan values, if present, form a value group.
